goal: Shrink transaction memory usage to stop denial-of-service attacks from crafted witness stacks
Prevent nodes from exhausting memory when deserializing transactions with many small witness elements
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Unaddressed objection: oversized elements throw and crash in noexcept accessors, no author reply (l0rinc)
Strong support because it cuts worst-case memory use so mempools fit more transactions (instagibbs)
Support because it reduces memory usage especially for empty witnesses and small elements (optout21)
Concept approval without stated reasons (w0xlt, xyzconstant, darosior, brunoerg)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it mitigates a memory-amplification denial-of-service attack against node operators
Worst-case in-memory transaction size drops from roughly 28 to 1.6 bytes per weight unit
The protection comes at a modest worst-case validation cost of 50 to 70 ms per block
